call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm with you and I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.no_thanks.note: fixed: now a light "oh, no, thanks". "لا يهمني الأمر" means "I don't care about it", which is blunt; the English is a light "Oh, no thanks".

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about this

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Ah, wait, I have another question
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: fixed: added the "wait" meaning with a word not in no_wait. English is "Oh wait, I've got one more question"; this drops the "wait" that stops the caller from hanging up, so it should mean "Oh, hold on, I have one more question".

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you dialed is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? | Ah, a package? Okay, leave it at the door, thank you very much. | Fine, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: goodbye | see you | in God's protection (farewell) | bye bye ;; wrapups: that's all | let's talk later | I'll call you later | okay, I'll hang up now ;; ends: Okay, thank you, goodbye. | Fine, see you. | That's all, thanks. ;; not_ends: Hello, this is Ahmed from the insurance company. | Would you like to meet tomorrow at the office? | You said you'd call me later, are you still wanting that?

notify.bl_announced_hint.note: fixed: says a voice announcement instead of a voicemail message. "الرسالة الصوتية" means a voicemail message, but here it is the announcement played to the blocked number.

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: number on the blacklist: the call was rejected during ringing (without AI)

notify.d_ai.note: fixed: label limited to 11 characters, so it uses the short common term for AI (ذكاء صناعي). The English label is "AI" but this says "the assistant", which differs from "الذكاء الاصطناعي" used everywhere else; use a short form that still says AI. Checked: ذكاء صناعي is a common variant of ذكاء اصطناعي (used widely, especially in Egypt), so readers take d_ai and s_reply as the same thing (AI).

notify.e_empty.back: (There is no summary and no call text)

notify.f_bad_time.back: The time "{}" could not be read

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: The callback was scheduled, but the phone control link is not connected. Make sure the phone is connected to the Bageo program, then confirm again.
notify.f_callback_waiting.note: Bageo is written in Latin letters after the word for program; mixed script in one sentence.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The callback number is not on the whitelist. Add it (or a prefix ending with the * sign) in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task will send an email but there is no reply address. Add the contact from the call text or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail has not been set up. Enter the Gmail address and the app password in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: The task could not be delivered to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw address and the Token in Settings)

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address doesn't look right. Check it in Settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address doesn't look right

notify.g_no_recipient.back: Not sent: there is no recipient address

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in Settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: the AI answered and spoke, and the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: the AI failed to connect; the system ended the call and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: the AI failed; the call was transferred to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: the rejection message was played and then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number on the blacklist: the message "the number is unavailable" was played and then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system considered the call a sales or fraud call ({t}); and stalling is off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system initially considered the call a sales or fraud call; then in a second check it became clear it was an ordinary call, so the AI returned to talking normally

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system considered the call a sales or fraud call ({t}), so the AI kept the caller talking deliberately to waste their time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system considered the call a sales or fraud call, so the AI kept the caller talking deliberately to waste their time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called its owner but did not reach them, and the AI told the caller that the phone's owner would call back soon; this call was not treated as a sales or fraud call that must be stalled, so what is required is to call them back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Long sentence for the summary model; check it still reads clearly.

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called its owner who answered and was connected to the caller, and the AI left the call; this call was not treated as a sales or fraud call that must be stalled

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said the matter was urgent and the phone's owner was alerted immediately; this call was not treated as a sales or fraud call that must be stalled, so what is required is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.list_sep.note: Uses the Arabic comma followed by a space.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: test the call sound

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot send the artificial intelligence's voice into calls.

notify.n_seconds.note: Single-letter abbreviation for seconds, as in the project's Arabic sample.

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: (The AI failed to connect; the system ended the call)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Asks to be called back on this number (confirmed by pressing 1, but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Wants a reply by email (confirmed by pressing 1, but the address is unknown)

notify.dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d/%-m instead of %b. %b prints an English month abbreviation (chrono here has no locale data), so the message would show e.g. "Nov" inside a Arabic text; use a numeric date such as %-d/%-m، %H:%M instead.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings a little before answering, as an ordinary person would. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max.back: Maximum duration of a normal call

console.f_knowledge.back: Information the AI can answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave them at reception. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6.
console.f_knowledge_ph.note: check: L06-charset (no line breaks allowed; unchanged from the earlier text, two examples as two sentences)

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts callers may ask about, one item per line. The AI will not make up anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: They are played when a call from the blacklist or from a hidden number is rejected. You can manage the blacklist from "Contacts".

console.b_help.back: End the number with the * sign to ban every number that starts with the same digits, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits not counting leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: End the call while ringing (it is not answered)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play the "unavailable" message, then end

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The rejection message is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Get a message when a call comes in and the summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: There are no notification channels yet. Add one so call summaries reach you on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Browse calls, ask the AI to make a call on your behalf, and deal with the to-dos directly from this chat. Send /help to show the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In groups, specify who can give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. In a private chat you can leave it empty. To find your ID ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First enable "Receive commands from this chat" in one of the notification channels above.

console.rc_env.back: Receive commands in the Telegram chat set by environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot name and chat ID taken from the environment variables TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. The variable TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS specifies the people authorized to send commands.

console.rc_errands.back: Calls on your behalf per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no calls on your behalf from chats. Maximum 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: After exceeding this number, that chat will not receive replies for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_title.back: Allow other AI tools to connect (MCP)

console.mcp_desc.back: Allows AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to view your calls and to-dos. Leave it off if you do not need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when this option is on and the Token below is set. The address is the console address with /mcp added.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: Can they request calls on your behalf?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in the chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: The "ask me first" option requires a chat that accepts commands.

console.mcp_errands.back: Maximum number of calls on your behalf per hour

console.mcp_errands_h.back: For all AI tools together, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave it empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot via @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you your ID; for a group use the group ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot a message once so that it is allowed to message you.

console.hint_discord.back: For notifications: enter a Webhook link (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook link) or the bot token with the channel ID; one of them is enough. To receive them in a private message, put your ID in place of the channel ID. For chat commands: enter the bot token and the channel ID, and enable Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: For notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook link (also applies to Mattermost) or enter the bot token with the channel ID; one of them is enough. For chat commands (Slack only): enable Socket Mode, then enter the bot token (xoxb-), the app token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE developer platform → Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. The LINE Notify service stopped in 2025 and this is the replacement.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it via the ntfy app. Leave the server empty to use ntfy.sh. A Token is only needed for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: open Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server link is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on iPhone and copy the device key from the sample link. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application on pushover.net to get an API token. The user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a bot to the group, then copy its Webhook link.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → bots → add a custom bot and copy the Webhook link. If you chose "Signature" as the security setting, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → bots → add bot → custom bot, then copy the Webhook link. Do not enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy the SendKey from the ServerChan website page.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your server (e.g. https://matrix.org), an access token for the sending account, and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Gmail address and the app password (Google account → Security → 2-step verification → App passwords). Not your normal password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification link of the Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. The tag determines which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any link that accepts a JSON POST request containing event, title, body and data. Suitable for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the link it gives you. The old Office 365 connectors have been discontinued.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps and integrations → Webhooks → add webhook, then copy its link. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → workspace → integrations → new → incoming (Incoming): enable it, choose the channel, and copy the Webhook link.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → bots → add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key in the format email:key. Destination: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more email addresses for a private message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy the access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email address.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Nextcloud address, user name and app password (Settings → Security) in the format user:password, and the conversation token, which is the last part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the Webhook link. On your local network, using an http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…), and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the destination empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email address.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy the token. The group code sends to that group; leaving it empty sends to you only.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: The simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website with no destination. Or your app's own appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server that supports TLS: for example smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login account is also the sender. Use the app password if your provider offers it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (profile → security), and the notification service such as mobile_app_pixel_9 (under developer tools → actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: The documentation section at ifttt.com/maker_webhooks shows your key. Create an applet titled "When receiving a web request via Webhooks" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; and with Docker, or to reach it from outside the home, type your own address.

console.use_this_url.back: Use the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. There is usually nothing to set up here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any software service compatible with OpenAI works, such as the following link: https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses the Gemini key by default. To use another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When the call settles on an appointment (delivery or appointment), a link "Add to calendar" is attached to the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to set an appointment, the AI does not agree immediately; instead it says it will check and get back to them. Then you press accept or decline under "To do" on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms.back: Send a text message to the caller

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you decide, the phone that received the call sends a text message to the caller (to mobile phone numbers only). Off: the AI calls them back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: a text message to a mobile phone, and a call-back on your behalf to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called (international, free and the like) do not receive a reply.

console.ar_call.back: Always a call-back on your behalf

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models whose name contains "thinking". The low level replies fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, enable USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the "Do you want to allow USB debugging?" window.

console.ph_offline.back: Not connected: disconnect the cable and connect it again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection works and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection setup is not complete yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network instead.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones connected via USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.usb_none.back: No phone was found via USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI what callers call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in "About you" so the AI seems closer to your style.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected at the moment. See the "Phones" section on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel so call summaries reach you on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Needs a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the call

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message reached the maximum duration

console.ev_vm_end_silence.back: The message ended after a period of silence

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller ended the call while leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not want a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: The caller did not choose a way to reply

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No response after the contact method was read out

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: The caller said the contact method is incorrect

console.ev_vm_reply_contact_confirmed.back: The caller confirmed the contact method

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked for a call back

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.back: The AI failed, transferred to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: The AI did not send sound, transferred to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI's sound could not be played, transferred to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: It came in during another call, rejected because the line was busy

console.nf_smtp_target.back: Send to (empty = same as login account)

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This message cannot be resent: the appointment has not been decided yet, or the message was already sent.

console.err_no_calendar.back: There is no calendar suggestion for this call.

console.err_no_audio.back: There is no recording of this type for this call.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background sound is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file for this background is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The audio sample could not be created. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be saved to disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be carried out.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not recognize this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: "{field}" must start with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or the password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service responded with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use an unencrypted room.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send to this address. Enter the address of your own notification service.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be reached.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the console via http://name.local. English letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with your phone's camera to open the console on it.

console.cu_local.back: This computer only can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to your home screen. Next time, just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon at the edge of the address bar (Chrome and Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some old Android phones) use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, and the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: The AI will no longer answer calls to this phone. It will ring like any normal phone and a person must answer himself. You can switch it back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a call. Try again after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still finishing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU, check that Bageo Uplink is enabled and then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not turn the ringer sound back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: The app on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The change has not been confirmed yet. Refresh this page after a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: an unexpected error occurred on the phone

console.pm_err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand this request

console.pill_all_normal.back: All phones are in normal phone mode

console.er_new.back: Ask the AI to make a call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, completes the task and tells you the result. During the call you can read the live text and direct the AI at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to search the contacts, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: There is no contact with this name. You can also type the number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list or type a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back: e.g. Book a table for 4 people tomorrow at 7 pm under the name Ali, non-smoking; if 7 is full, 7:30 to 8 is also fine. Or: Ask him which day on the weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner
console.er_task_ph.note: fixed: the two examples are now two sentences (no line breaks allowed by L06)

console.er_task_h.back: Explain what you want done and what you can accept. If the AI hesitates during the call, it will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf as your assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks as you yourself.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (an available line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot make calls on your behalf. Return it to AI-answering mode on the System page.

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so the AI does not have to stop and ask you during the call.

console.er_started.back: Handed over to the AI. It is calling now.

console.er_queued.back: Queued. The AI will call as soon as a phone becomes available.

console.er_empty_title.back: There are no call tasks yet

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what you want done. The AI will call, handle the matter and tell you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody answers or the line is busy, it calls again every minute up to 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Redial until answered: attempt {n} had no answer, it will call again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Calling, waiting for the other party to answer…

console.er_watching.back: You are now watching: when in doubt the AI will ask you first.

console.er_who_ai.note: fixed: AI is called the AI everywhere else

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will decide

console.er_tell.note: fixed: AI is called the AI everywhere else

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell him that 8 pm is also fine

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI will end the call immediately. The task may not have been completed yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other party

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not present, without an answer

console.er_ans_timeout.back: The question was not answered in the allotted time

console.er_options.back: Their options. Choose one so that the AI calls back and informs them of it:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and ask the AI to call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will call {who} again and reply with this.

console.er_fu_go.note: fixed: AI is called the AI everywhere else

console.er_delete_b.back: It will be removed from this list, and the call records will remain.

console.er_err_no_number.back: Enter the number to be called.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: This number does not look correct.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (an emergency, special or paid number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: There is no phone with a SIM card that can call numbers of this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not received a call yet, so the system does not know the cards in it. Call it once and then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what you want the AI to do.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: The text is too long: a maximum of 1000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No phone is available for the AI at the moment (no phone is connected, or all are in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This call task or this contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still waiting or in progress. Try again after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI cannot convey this speech.

console.er_ct_call.note: fixed: button action, asks the AI to call

console.f_er_identity.back: Calls on your behalf: call as

console.f_er_identity_h.back: In what capacity the AI introduces itself when it calls on your behalf. A different capacity can be chosen for each call task.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; they can be transferred to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Stall list (the AI prolongs the conversation with them from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls coming from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you and when. This does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Not answering: transfer directly to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers, and transfers you if the matter is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls when there is an urgent matter.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: Once set, the console asks for it when opened (once per browser). It is required to open the console from your phone or from another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this console from outside your home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. You will be asked to enter it again on any new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must consist of at least 8 characters.

console.g_region_d.back: Most users do not need these settings.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, specify who can give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. In private messages you can leave it empty. To find your ID: enable developer mode, then right-click your name → Copy user ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, specify who can give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. In private messages you can leave it empty. To find the member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room that includes others, specify who can give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. A room that includes only you and the bot can be left empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Browse calls, ask the AI to make a call on your behalf, and deal with the to-dos directly from this chat. Send "@bot_name /help" to show the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Browse calls, ask the AI to make a call on your behalf, and deal with the to-dos directly from this chat. Send "@bot_name /help" to show the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent matter: you were connected to the caller

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent matter: you could not be reached

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent matter: the AI left while calling you

console.urg_why_ended.back: the call directed to you ended

console.urg_why_merge.back: Could not connect you to the caller

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not make the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: The text is too long. Please shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question was already answered or its time has expired.

console.d_del_call_b.back: The summary, the call transcript and the recording will be permanently deleted.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All finished calls and their recordings will be permanently deleted. Calls in progress will remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait until the call ends before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this disconnected phone from the list. Previous call records remain.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone first before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the call currently in progress on this phone ends.

console.bl_mode.back: When a number on the blacklist calls:

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choose the voice of the rejection message

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only blacklist numbers can end with the * sign, with at least 3 digits before it not counting leading zeros.

console.sms_search_ph.back: Search for the sender or the text

console.sms_empty_t.back: There are no text messages yet

console.sms_empty_d.back: The text messages your phones receive appear here as soon as message forwarding is running.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation or press "New message".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send text messages right now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: You cannot reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: The phone's app is too old to send text messages.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The phone's app does not have permission to send text messages. Allow it from the phone.

console.sms_err_no_service.back: There is no signal on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send the message.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The selected SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls, recordings, text messages, call tasks and to-dos older than this period are automatically deleted.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can also connect via Wi-Fi

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: a phone connected once via USB keeps working over Wi-Fi after the cable is unplugged. Off: phones connect via USB only.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if you lost a phone or another person used it.

console.repair_b.back: Phones connected via Wi-Fi will be disconnected. Connect each phone with a USB cable again to reconnect it.

console.repair_done.back: The phones were re-paired. Connect each phone that works over Wi-Fi with a USB cable once.

console.g_backup_d.back: Backup files contain your keys and passwords. Keep them in a place no one else can reach.

console.bk_dir_h.back: Leave it empty to use the default folder, or type the full path of another folder.

console.bk_calls.back: Include call records, recordings and text messages

console.bk_calls_h.back: The size of the backup files will become much larger.

console.bk_files_empty.back: There are no backup files yet.

console.bk_item_numbers.back: Your number notes and scam numbers

console.bk_dlg_has.back: Choose what you want to restore:

console.bk_warn_newer_version.back: This backup is from a newer version of Bageo. Some settings may not work here.

console.bk_warn_plain_settings_file.back: This is a simple settings file, so only the settings will be restored.

console.bk_warn_password.back: The console password will change to the password saved in this backup.

console.bk_dlg_note.back: Before restoring, Bageo saves your current settings in a separate file.
